propositions: Under xdist with -n 3 --dist worksteal, the process-local lru_cache on _rendered() causes each of three workers to independently render all 178 corpus bodies (~884 pandoc spawns), tripling CPU work versus serial execution.
The three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical tests each recompute pass-1 renders that are already cached by _rendered(), causing redundant pandoc invocations.

A session-scoped shared artifact stored in tmp_path_factory.getbasetemp().parent and keyed by SHA-256 digest of corpus files, renderer source, and pandoc executable eliminates per-worker duplication while remaining session-hermetic.

Sharding the artifact per stratum (code_arrow/table/prose) with worker-rotated probe order and os.mkdir-based locking prevents concurrent workers from queueing on the same shard and allows a cold session to cost one stratum of wall time instead of the whole corpus.
